## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run pytest`, `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .` and `uv run mypy` pass.
- [ ] Changes to adding, renaming or removing radios have a test proving unrelated radios are left alone.
- [ ] New Music Assistant commands link to their definition in the server source.
- [ ] User-facing strings are in `strings.json` and `translations/en.json` (and `nl.json` if you can).
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under **Unreleased**.
